note: The open world as it runs (roadmap items 39, 45, 48, 49, 50, 52; core/game/game_sandbox.gd). The heir's tiles, the creatures kept round them and the companions' threats are numbers here, not in code. Text is here too, so the screen and the log say the same thing.

tiles.note: The open world drawn as tile chunks (ui/play/tile_view.gd). px is a tile's size in the atlas, chunk the tiles to a TileMapLayer, keep the chunks kept beyond the view. Each kind (a biome, water, a built piece) has a colour; a stand-in for sprite art, which replaces the atlas and nothing else.

text.not_a_step: The heir can only step to a tile beside them.
text.edge: The edge of the world is there.
text.no_route: There is no way there from here.
text.blocked: Something stands in the way: water, a tree, rock or a wall.
text.dug: The family digs down {depth} into the ground.
text.stairs_blocked: There is nothing to stand on at the top of the stairs.
text.stairs_bottom: There are no stairs below to go down by.
text.upstairs_route: Routes are for the ground: walk up here with the stick.
text.upstairs_dig: The family can only dig from the ground.
text.fell: The floor gave way and {heir} dropped to the ground.
text.no_door: There is no door here to go in by.
text.no_exit: The way out is back at the door.
